name: EVMbench
intro: EVMbench评估AI智能体检测、修补和利用高危智能合约漏洞的能力。论文从公开审计报告和Tempo安全场景出发，经自动筛选与OtterSec专家质检得到40次审计中的120个漏洞；检测覆盖全部120个漏洞，修补覆盖22个仓库的45个漏洞，利用覆盖16个仓库的24个漏洞。
build_method: 公开审计报告筛选, OtterSec专家质检, 隔离任务环境, 三模式隐藏验证
metric: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
task_type: 智能合约漏洞检测, 修补, 利用
eval_feature: 检测用GPT-5报告匹配, 修补用隐藏利用测试, 利用用交易重放与Rust状态评分器
scale: 120个漏洞/40次审计；修补45个/22仓库；利用24个/16仓库
build_method_en: Public Audit-report Screening, OtterSec Expert QC, Isolated Task Environments, Three-mode Hidden Verification
eval_feature_en: GPT-5 Report Matching for Detect, Hidden Exploit Tests for Patch, Transaction Replay and Rust State Grader for Exploit
intro_en: EVMbench evaluates agents on detecting, patching, and exploiting high-severity smart-contract vulnerabilities. The paper filters public audit findings and Tempo security scenarios, then uses OtterSec expert QC to obtain 120 vulnerabilities from 40 audits; Detect covers all 120, Patch covers 45 vulnerabilities in 22 repositories, and Exploit covers 24 in 16 repositories.
scale_en: 120 vulnerabilities / 40 audits; Patch 45 / 22 repositories; Exploit 24 / 16 repositories
metric_en: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the EVMbench paper (OpenAI, Paradigm, OtterSec). The paper's final benchmark count of 120 vulnerabilities from 40 audits controls over the OpenAI launch-page summary of 117. Most cases originate in Code4rena reports; o3 first identifies high-severity loss-of-funds findings, then license, language, date, reproducibility, and expert-quality gates are applied, with selected Tempo scenarios added. Detect uses all 120 cases and GPT-5 matching of submitted audit reports to ground truth. Patch uses 45 vulnerabilities from 22 repositories and combines reset/original tests with unseen exploit tests. Exploit uses 24 vulnerabilities from 16 repositories, replays submitted transactions against local Anvil, and applies a separate Rust chain-state grader. Every setting is run three times and reported with rates, bootstrap confidence intervals, and cost.
